facebookAccount.userAgent: Mozilla/5.0 (Linux; Android 12; M2102J20SG) AppleWebKit/537.36 (KHTML, like Gecko) Chrome/101.0.0.0 Mobile Safari/537.36
facebookAccount.notes: time the system automatically retrieves new cookies from email/password, unit is minute, if you set null, the system will not automatically retrieve new cookies, it saves you from having to update cookies frequently

notesLanguage: change to your language with ISO 639-1 code, available languages: vi (Vietnamese), en (English)

whiteListMode.notes: if you enable this feature, only the ids in the whiteListIds section can use the bot

database.notes: (1) type selects 'json' or 'sqlite' or 'mongodb'. If you choose mongodb, enter uri connect mongodb in the uriMongodb section

autoRestart.notes: you can set time is interval with milisecond or cron time, example: 1000, 10000, 60000, 3600000, 86400000, 0 0 *

autoUptime.notes: the value of timeInterval is seconds, url is the url you want to send the request to

autoLoadScripts.notes: this feature will automatically load the script when scripts have been changed

restartListenMqtt.notes: the value of timeRestart and delayAfterStopListening is milisecond

notiWhenListenMqttError.notes: This is the message when the bot is listening to the mqtt server and the mqtt server stops working

gmail.note: Bot will use gmailAccount to send email to emailGetNoti

telegram.note: Can send notifications to many chatId, separate by comma or space

discordHook.note: Can send notifications to many webhookUrl, separate by comma or space
